summary:
Main
Today's decline extended across domestic futures, port spot and seaborne markets, testing the earlier recovery again. DCE most-tradedclosed at 669.0 yuan/mt, down 1.83%, and all eight Qingdao products fell 9 yuan/wmt. The seaborne 61% index eased to USD 88.60/dmt and the 65% to 106.25, with all 12 brands lower.
